summary: The agent sets up a reasonably structured LightGBM regression pipeline but introduces a critical data leakage flaw through naive target encoding on the training set. Additionally, it identifies ID columns but neglects to drop them, allowing identifiers to be used as model features. Standard evaluation practices are also missed, such as multiple evaluations for stochastic models and multi-metric assessment.
